crosswalks.label: Web and Digital Interface Designers
crosswalks.rationale: Web and Digital Interface Designers explicitly include accessibility/usability concerns but also broader design work outside software-accessibility engineering.

crosswalks.label: Software Developers
crosswalks.rationale: Software Developers ground implementation/runtime behavior while accessibility requirement interpretation and lived-user evidence remain separate.

findings.summary: Accessibility engineering combines interface implementation with specialized evidence boundaries; automated semantics and synthetic input must not be collapsed into conformance or lived-user success.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the profession boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make automation/tree evidence, synthetic interaction, human/AT experience and legal/full-conformance authority separate surfaces.

nonclaims: No complete Software Accessibility Engineer reconstruction is claimed.
Occupational mappings are evidence, not profession identity.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No adjacent professional, user, legal, platform or institutional authority is created.
